facts.m4_ar_true_overlap: P(AR active | M4 active) = 91%; severity corr(M4, AR) = 0.4951 -> multiplicative combine double-discounts a shared shock
facts.midband_overdefense: months with total beta < 0.5 (45m incl deep): base mean +1.4%/mo -> de-risking in the mid band destroyed value; implied mid-only (excl 6 deep months) approx +3.1%/mo
facts.deep_derisk_accurate: months with total beta < 0.25 (6m): base mean -9.83%/mo -> deep de-risking was correct and must be preserved
facts.m4_r05_overlap: P(R05|M4)=18% (partial) - R05 layer explicitly OUT OF SCOPE this cycle

incumbent_structure.formula: ret_L5_V2 = beta_R05_V2 * beta_threshold_lag * m4_weight_lag * ret_orig - db_thr*0.0015 - db_R05_V2*0.0015
incumbent_structure.combine_under_test: g_inc = beta_threshold_lag * m4_weight_lag  (AR x M4 multiplicative product; the non-R05 exposure combine)
incumbent_structure.base_monthly_source: 04_Research/strategies/STR_1715_WT016_Iter31_GridBestProd/output/03_period_returns.csv (ret_orig == base ret_net, identity verified in v24_book_remeasure)

verified_identities_metric_type_diagnost.note: production cost legs charge |delta beta_AR| and |delta beta_R05| only; m4_weight path changes are UNCHARGED in the stored series. See cost_convention below for the uniform A/B re-pricing.
verified_identities_metric_type_diagnost.verification_script: 04_Research/composition_search/cycle1_trackO/inspect_inputs.R (run 2026-06-12, input inspection only - no candidate performance computed)

invariant_constraints.rule: GLOBAL DEEP-GUARD applied to every candidate: in any month where incumbent total beta b_inc_t = beta_threshold_lag * m4_weight_lag * beta_R05_V2 < 0.25, the candidate combine is overridden to g_cand_t := g_inc_t (incumbent product), so candidate total beta equals incumbent total beta EXACTLY in those months (6 months on realized path). B2 verdict: deep de-risking accurate (-9.83%/mo base) - crisis defense must not be weakened.
invariant_constraints.audit: mandatory per-candidate report: max|beta_cand - beta_inc| over the 6 deep months must be 0 (machine epsilon).

invariant_constraints.rule: beta_R05_V2 path and its cost leg are consumed AS STORED. No candidate may modify, re-trigger, or re-weight the R05 layer (replacement is a follow-up cycle, out of scope).

Every candidate g is a pointwise function of the already-lagged realized columns (beta_threshold_lag, m4_weight_lag) of month t only. No new signals, no re-estimation, no fitted parameters (the rho=0.4951 constant in O4/O5 is a FROZEN B2 diagnostic value, fixed here pre-measurement, not tuned). PIT is inherited from the production lagged paths (C5 t-1 convention already applied upstream).
All 5 candidates reported in full on all 4 windows regardless of selection outcome. selection_type=sweep, n_trials=5 counted in cumulative trial ledger.

candidates.formula: g = min(beta_AR, m4_weight); deep-guard per INV-O1
candidates.mechanism: Severity corr 0.50 + P(AR|M4)=91% mean the product stacks two discounts for one shared shock; min() takes the single most severe signal (max-severity OR-dedup), removing the double subtraction entirely.

candidates.formula: g = m4_weight if m4_weight < 1 else beta_AR; deep-guard per INV-O1
candidates.mechanism: P(AR|M4)=91% means AR carries almost no independent information inside M4-active months; let M4 own the discount when it fires (33m) and let AR act only standalone (M4-inactive months) - conditional dedup rather than pointwise min.

candidates.formula: g = g_inc if g_inc < 0.25 else max(g_inc, 0.5); deep-guard per INV-O1
candidates.mechanism: B2 band evidence directly: mid-band de-risking cost +1.4%/mo base (deep band accurate), so clamp only the mid band of the combine to 0.5 and leave both the full-exposure and deep paths untouched.

candidates.formula: g = (beta_AR * m4_weight)^(1/(1+0.4951)) = product^0.66888; deep-guard per INV-O1
candidates.mechanism: Correlation-corrected product: with severity corr rho, effective independent signal count is ~2/(1+rho), so the joint discount exponent is tempered by 1/(1+rho) - a continuous, monotone softening of the double-discount (rho=0.4951 frozen from B2, not fitted).

Convex interpolation between the independence limit (product correct) and the full-redundancy limit (min correct), weighted by the measured redundancy rho=0.4951 - the combine sits where the diagnosed overlap says it should.

reference_arms_not_trials.formula: g = beta_AR * m4_weight (current production combine), re-priced under the uniform cost convention below
reference_arms_not_trials.role: A/B baseline. Also report stored ret_L5_V2 (production cost convention) as a second reference row for traceability.

series_construction.delta_convention: delta g at t=1 measured against initial exposure 1.0 (matches production: first row betas=1, db=0). db_R05_V2 consumed as stored.
series_construction.cost_convention: UNIFORM v2.4-delta legs for A/B: 15bps per leg on |delta of combined non-R05 exposure g| + stored R05 leg. Applied identically to all 5 candidates AND the incumbent reference (note: this re-prices the incumbent slightly vs stored ret_L5_V2, because production charged |delta beta_AR| only and left the m4 leg uncharged - both incumbent rows reported, labeled). Rationale: candidates that move mid-band exposure must not be advantaged/penalized by an inconsistent leg definition.
series_construction.engine: PerformanceAnalytics standard functions only (xts + table.AnnualizedReturns scale=12 + maxDrawdown). No prod/cumprod self-synthesis. Recomposition arithmetic on realized paths is permitted because the identical identity reproduces stored ret_L5_V2 at 5.1e-16 (verified above).
series_construction.metric_type_label: estimated (realized-artifact recomposition, v24_book_remeasure precedent). Forge-authoritative re-run is required before any graduation/admission claim - this A/B alone grades nothing.

windows.IS_selection: realized_ym 2005-01 .. 2018-12 (168m) - the ONLY window used to select

evaluation_prereg.selection_rule: argmax IS net SR over the 5 candidates. Tie-break (|dSR| < 0.005): lower IS MDD. OOS values MUST NOT be inspected before the IS winner is committed to the results file.
evaluation_prereg.oos_confirmation_rule: Selected candidate CONFIRMED iff (OOS net SR >= incumbent_repriced OOS net SR - 0.05) AND (OOS MDD <= incumbent_repriced OOS MDD + 3pp absolute). On failure: report FAIL honestly, no second pick from OOS, cycle ends with a negative result and an L-code.
